roadmap.title: Playthrough 1: opening and first racket
roadmap.description: Take the early bayou kills while enemies are easy to use: feed a body to an alligator, kick a door, and farm molotov throwers in the second mission. Then wiretap the first racket.

roadmap.title: Playthrough 1: recruit the underbosses and start rackets
roadmap.description: Play the story until Cassandra, Burke, and Vito join. Flip every racket boss and recruit every informant from now on, and give each racket to the underboss who gets its district. Do the driving and takedown counts as chances come.

roadmap.title: Playthrough 1: late story and underboss missions
roadmap.description: Finish the flip counts, keep three districts with each underboss, and finish all 15 underboss side missions before the last district falls.

roadmap.title: Playthrough 1: ending, money, and DLC missions
roadmap.description: Finish the story with all three underbosses alive, then earn and spend the money totals and clear the three story add-ons that come with this edition.

roadmap.title: Playthrough 2: kill run
roadmap.description: Start a new game. Kill every racket boss and informant, give all districts to one underboss, and skip the other two underbosses' side missions so you can kill them near the end.

achievements.description: Decide Lincoln's fate and watch the full end credits.
achievements.summary: Decide Lincoln's fate and watch the full end credits.

guide.context: The credits are very long and cannot be skipped. Do not return to the menu early.

steps.text: Make the final choice about Lincoln's fate after @loc{Yet Here We Are}.
Watch the whole credits. The achievement unlocks when they end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Pray on the Way Up".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Pray on the Way Up".

steps.text: Play @loc{Pray on the Way Up} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "It's a Brave New World".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "It's a Brave New World".

steps.text: Play @loc{It's a Brave New World} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Fish Gotta Eat".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Fish Gotta Eat".

steps.text: Play @loc{Fish Gotta Eat} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Everyone Will Notice".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Everyone Will Notice".

steps.text: Play @loc{Everyone Will Notice} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "My Name is Lincoln Clay".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "My Name is Lincoln Clay".

steps.text: Play @loc{My Name is Lincoln Clay} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Little Late for That".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Little Late for That".

steps.text: Play @loc{Little Late for That} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "The Poor Sumb****".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "The Poor Sumb****".

steps.text: Play @loc{The Poor Sumb****} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Burn Like Napalm".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Burn Like Napalm".

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Certainly Was Exciting".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Certainly Was Exciting".

steps.text: Play @loc{Certainly Was Exciting} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the final story mission "Yet Here We Are".
achievements.summary: Complete the final story mission "Yet Here We Are".

guide.context: The game checks your underbosses here, so settle their districts first.

steps.text: Play @loc{Yet Here We Are} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Somethin' I've Gotta Do".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Somethin' I've Gotta Do".

steps.text: Play @loc{Somethin' I've Gotta Do} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "For Old Time's Sake".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "For Old Time's Sake".

guide.context: Cassandra joins you as an underboss here.

steps.text: Play @loc{For Old Time's Sake} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Cut & Run".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Cut & Run".

guide.context: Burke joins you as an underboss here.

steps.text: Play @loc{Cut & Run} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "We Partners Now".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "We Partners Now".

guide.context: Vito joins you as an underboss here.

steps.text: Play @loc{We Partners Now} to the end.

achievements.description: Unlocked all Associates
achievements.summary: Unlock all 9 associates.

guide.context: Each underboss has 3 associates. Each starts with one district from the story; the rest are your choice.

steps.text: Give @npc{Cassandra}, @npc{Burke}, and @npc{Vito} 3 districts each, with every racket in them.
Visit the speech-bubble icons on the map to meet new lieutenants.

achievements.description: Completed all of Burke's side-missions
achievements.summary: Complete all of Burke's side missions.

guide.context: This needs control of 3 regions and Burke alive. Do it in the same playthrough you keep all underbosses alive.

steps.text: Take Burke's vehicle missions and deliver all five vehicles.
After each car drop-off, enter and leave his office to get your own car back.
When delivering a boat, keep it moving as you leave and step onto the dock instead of swimming.

achievements.description: Completed all of Vito's side-missions
achievements.summary: Complete all of Vito's side missions.

guide.context: This needs control of 3 regions and Vito alive. Do it in the same playthrough you keep all underbosses alive.

steps.text: Take Vito's kill missions and finish all five.

achievements.description: Completed all of Cassandra's side-missions
achievements.summary: Complete all of Cassandra's side missions.

guide.context: This needs control of 3 regions and Cassandra alive. Do it in the same playthrough you keep all underbosses alive.

steps.text: Take Cassandra's truck missions and bring her all five trucks.

achievements.description: Saved $150,000 between your wallet and the bank
achievements.summary: Have $150,000 in total across your wallet and your bank account.

guide.context: Dying loses half of the cash in your wallet.

steps.text: Deposit your cash. After Vito joins, call the Consigliere to bank your wallet.
Keep earning from missions and rackets until the total reaches $150,000.

achievements.description: Earned $500,000
achievements.summary: Earn $500,000 in total.

guide.context: This counts everything you earn, not what you hold, and it keeps adding up in a new playthrough.

steps.text: Earn money from missions, racket kickback, and pickups until your total earned reaches $500,000.

achievements.description: Got the maximum earn from one of your Rackets
achievements.summary: Bring one of your rackets to its maximum earn.

guide.context: Giving @npc{Cassandra} @loc{Delray Hollow} lets you meet @npc{Emmanual} early.

steps.text: Give a district and its rackets to an underboss.
Meet the lieutenant at the speech-bubble icon on the map.
Finish that racket's missions until its icon shows maximum income.

achievements.description: Keep all three underbosses alive through to "Yet Here We Are".
achievements.summary: Keep all three underbosses alive through to "Yet Here We Are".

guide.context: Use your first playthrough for this. It cannot share a playthrough with Just You and Me.

steps.text: Give @npc{Cassandra}, @npc{Burke}, and @npc{Vito} 3 districts each.
Give each racket to the same underboss who gets its district.
Do not move a district to someone else at an underboss meeting.
Reach @loc{Yet Here We Are} with all three alive.

achievements.description: Keep just one underboss alive through to "Yet Here We Are", with the other two killed.
achievements.summary: Keep just one underboss alive through to "Yet Here We Are", with the other two killed.

guide.context: Use a new playthrough for this. Each underboss starts with one district, so the 6 you assign decide it. Finishing a side-mission chain can remove the option to kill that underboss. This cannot share a playthrough with Family or We're in This Together.

steps.text: Pick one underboss to keep.
Give that underboss every district you can assign, with all its rackets.
Skip side missions for the other two.
Kill the other two when the game offers it near the end. The achievement unlocks after your last meeting with the one you kept.

achievements.description: Reach the loyal state with one underboss.
achievements.summary: Reach the loyal state with one underboss.

guide.context: Do not kill that underboss at the end.

steps.text: Give one underboss 3 districts.
Finish all of that underboss's side missions.

achievements.description: Make all three underbosses loyal.
achievements.summary: Make all three underbosses loyal.

guide.context: Plan 2 to 3 hours for the missions and finish them in one session if you can. This cannot share a playthrough with Just You and Me.

steps.text: Give each underboss 3 districts.
Finish all 15 side missions: Burke's, Vito's, and Cassandra's.
Do not kill any underboss.

achievements.description: Spent at least $500,000
achievements.summary: Spend at least $500,000 in total.

guide.context: Spending also keeps adding up in a new playthrough.

steps.text: Call the arms dealer from the weapon wheel and buy things until you have spent $500,000 in total.

achievements.description: Received $10,000 in earn from one Underboss
achievements.summary: Receive $10,000 of earn at once from one underboss.

guide.context: One underboss needs about eight fully upgraded rackets across 4 districts, or roughly twelve plain rackets across 6 districts.

steps.text: Give every district and its rackets to one underboss.
Let the earn build above $10,000 and collect it yourself before calling the Consigliere.

achievements.description: Flipped 16 Racket Bosses
achievements.summary: Flip 16 racket bosses.

guide.context: The first two bosses die in the story and do not count. Every other boss must be flipped, so one kill ruins this playthrough. Do not use this playthrough for No Loose Ends. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Wiretap the junction box in the zone that holds the boss's base.
Fight the boss and weaken him with melee.
Choose to flip him, not kill him.
Repeat until the journal shows 16 flipped bosses.

achievements.description: Recruited 15 Racket Informants
achievements.summary: Recruit 15 racket informants.

guide.context: The informant in the opening story is killed and does not count. A few extras exist, so one kill is fine. Do not use this playthrough for Can't Trust a Rat.

steps.text: Find an informant on the map during a racket's objectives.
Hide behind cover and whistle to draw the informant in unseen.
Grab the informant and choose to recruit.

achievements.description: Killed all of the Racket Bosses
achievements.summary: Kill all of the racket bosses.

guide.context: The first two bosses die in the story anyway. Flipping any boss ruins this playthrough. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Skip wiretapping a boss's zone.
Shoot the boss down and take the kill prompt.

achievements.description: Killed 15 Racket Informants
achievements.summary: Kill 15 racket informants.

guide.context: A few extras exist, so one recruit is fine. Do not use the playthrough you recruit them in. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Find an informant on the map during a racket's objectives.
Capture the informant and choose to kill.

achievements.description: Drove at 120 mph or faster for 20 seconds
achievements.summary: Reach 120 mph or faster and hold it for 20 seconds.

guide.context: If it is hard, wait for speed upgrades later in the story.

steps.text: Use a fast car: a @item{De'Leo Stiletto}, or a tuned @item{Samson Duke} or @item{Samson Opus}.
Start in south-west @loc{Frisco Fields}, cross the bridge to @loc{Barclay Mills}, go through the tunnel, and keep your speed down the hill.

achievements.description: While driving, performed a 50-meter jump and landed on your wheels
achievements.summary: While driving, perform a 50-meter jump and land on your wheels.

guide.context: Sinclair Parish also has many ramps.

steps.text: Use a fast car and take a long run-up to the dirt ramp at the construction site in north-west @loc{Frisco Fields}.
Land on all four wheels.

achievements.description: While driving, drifted for at least 5 seconds
achievements.summary: While driving, drift for at least 5 seconds.

steps.text: Use a fast car on a wide road or muddy roadside.
Slide the car sideways for 5 seconds without a break.

achievements.description: Made a 180 degree turn at high speed without hitting anything
achievements.summary: Spin a car around to face the other way at speed without crashing into anything.

steps.text: Drive fast on an open road, pull the handbrake, and steer until you face the other way without a crash.

achievements.description: Executed 10 Vehicle Takedowns
achievements.summary: Execute 10 vehicle takedowns.

guide.context: A car only counts when it flips, and slow driving can stop that. You can spread the 10 across several chases.

steps.text: Drive fast while police chase you.
Look behind you, aim at a chasing car's tires with a pistol, and shoot until it flips.

achievements.description: Killed 300 enemies using Takedowns
achievements.summary: Kill 300 enemies using takedowns.

guide.context: Normal, stealth, and brutal takedowns all count. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Fight hostile police or a racket boss's location and use takedowns on everyone.
Walk at least 100 m away to reset the location and repeat.

achievements.description: Performed 100 Stealth Takedowns on enemies
achievements.summary: Perform 100 stealth takedowns.

guide.context: Takedowns only count as stealth while the minimap is not in combat. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Sneak up behind an enemy who has not noticed you and press melee. Whistle from cover to bring them to you.

achievements.description: Performed 50 Brutal Takedowns
achievements.summary: Perform 50 brutal takedowns.

guide.context: Pick weak enemies so a missed cue does little damage. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Hit an aware enemy with 3 quick melee attacks.
Hold melee and release it when the on-screen cue and sound appear.

achievements.description: Completely weakened a Racket by killing all of its Enforcers
achievements.summary: Kill all of one racket's enforcers before attacking its boss.

guide.context: Every racket has enforcers, so you can try again on the next racket.

steps.text: Pick a racket and do every objective with a skull icon on the map.
Kill the enforcers at each one. The achievement unlocks after the last.

achievements.description: Attacked a Racket without killing any Enforcers
achievements.summary: Attack a racket boss's hideout without killing any of its enforcers.

steps.text: Pick a racket and skip every skull-icon objective.
Start the attack on the boss's hideout.

achievements.description: Wiretapped the Delray Hollow Smack Racket
achievements.summary: Wiretap the Delray Hollow Smack Racket.

guide.context: This is part of the story.

steps.text: Follow the story until it has you wiretap the @loc{Delray Hollow} Smack Racket, and do it.

achievements.description: Performed 5 headshots in 5 seconds
achievements.summary: Perform 5 headshots in 5 seconds.

guide.context: You can buy the @item{Screaming Zemi} from the arms dealer after the first racket boss.

steps.text: Group several enemies. Whistle at them or throw a @item{Screaming Zemi} from the arms dealer.
Use a rapid-fire weapon and shoot each in the head at close range. Slow-mo helps.

achievements.description: Fed a body to an alligator
achievements.summary: Feed a body to an alligator.

guide.context: Alligators live in the bayou water in the south of the map.

steps.text: Pick up a dead body, such as the guard in the first mission.
Throw it into the water where an @enemy{alligator} swims.

achievements.description: Got eaten by an alligator
achievements.summary: Get eaten by an alligator.

steps.text: Jump into the bayou water where an @enemy{alligator} lives and swim until one kills you.

achievements.description: Chained together 3 or more Brutal Takedowns
achievements.summary: Chain 3 or more brutal takedowns.

guide.context: Enemies often stumble when they see one. Attacking too soon turns the next one into a normal takedown.

steps.text: Fight weak enemies such as police, on a low difficulty with adrenaline shots ready.
Do three brutal takedowns with no other kills between them and no long gaps.

achievements.description: Stole a Police car
achievements.summary: Steal a police car.

steps.text: Cause trouble until police arrive, or find a parked police car.
Take out the officers nearby and drive off in the car.

achievements.description: Escaped a Police Zone after being chased for 2 minutes
achievements.summary: Lose the police after a chase that has lasted 2 minutes.

guide.context: You do not have to run out of the zone; the police need to lose you.

steps.text: Cause trouble until a police chase starts.
Break their line of sight and hide inside the blue circle until 2 minutes have passed and the police lose you.

achievements.description: Killed an enemy within 2 seconds of kicking open a door
achievements.summary: Kick a door open and kill someone within 2 seconds.

guide.context: Metal doors cannot be kicked. The first door in @loc{The Home Fires Burn} is a good first door, but not the door to the miniboss @enemy{Baka}, who cannot be killed. More crowbar doors appear in later missions.

steps.text: Walk up to a crowbar door and press melee to kick it open.
Shoot an enemy behind it right away. A shotgun or rifle works best.

achievements.description: Made 10 enemies kill themselves with their own Molotovs
achievements.summary: Get 10 enemies to set themselves on fire with their own molotovs.

guide.context: Best in the early mission @loc{The Home Fires Burn}. Use a weak pistol on the molotov thrower so it does not kill him outright. Later enemies throw grenades more, so do it early. A later spot for this is @loc{All for the Blessed}, a Sign of the Times mission. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Take cover. A thrower shouts a warning before he throws.
Shoot him as he winds up so he drops the molotov and burns.
Die to the other enemies to retry. Do not reload a checkpoint. Repeat until you have 10.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Real Nice Time".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Real Nice Time".

steps.text: Play @loc{Real Nice Time} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "The Connection to Cuba".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "The Connection to Cuba".

steps.text: Play @loc{The Connection to Cuba} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "There's a War Goin' On".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "There's a War Goin' On".

steps.text: Play @loc{There's a War Goin' On} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the story mission "Jesuit in New Mexico".
achievements.summary: Complete the story mission "Jesuit in New Mexico".

steps.text: Play @loc{Jesuit in New Mexico} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Faster, Baby! story mission "Another Brother Falls".
achievements.summary: Complete the Faster, Baby! story mission "Another Brother Falls".

guide.context: Faster, Baby! missions use light blue map markers.

steps.text: Play @loc{Another Brother Falls} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Faster, Baby! story mission "Kickin' Up Dust".
achievements.summary: Complete the Faster, Baby! story mission "Kickin' Up Dust".

steps.text: Play @loc{Kickin' Up Dust} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Faster, Baby! story mission "Ain't Nowhere Safer".
achievements.summary: Complete the Faster, Baby! story mission "Ain't Nowhere Safer".

steps.text: Play @loc{Ain't Nowhere Safer} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Faster, Baby! story mission "Concerned Citizens".
achievements.summary: Complete the Faster, Baby! story mission "Concerned Citizens".

guide.context: This is the last story mission of the add-on.

steps.text: Play @loc{Concerned Citizens} to the end.

achievements.description: Reached the Max Herbalism level
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum Herbalism level.

steps.text: Grow weed and do the weed missions until you reach the top level.

achievements.description: Fully upgraded the Grow House
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade the Grow House.

steps.text: Reach the maximum Herbalism level first.
Buy every Grow House upgrade. It costs $105,000 in total.

achievements.description: Sold a single batch of weed for $10,000 or more
achievements.summary: Sell a single weed batch for at least $10,000.

steps.text: Upgrade the Grow House a couple of times.
Sell a full batch for at least $10,000.

achievements.description: Destroyed 10 of Slim's re-election billboards
achievements.summary: Smash 10 billboards that carry Slim's campaign.

guide.context: Only billboards with Slim's face count. Several break in Faster, Baby! story missions.

steps.text: Jump through billboards with Slim's face around Sinclair Parish.
Drive far away so they reset, and hit the same ones again. Repeats count.

achievements.description: Killed 30 enemies using Proximity Mines
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies using Proximity Mines.

guide.context: Vehicle kills do not count. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Throw a proximity mine at groups like a grenade so it blows on contact.
Repeat until you have 30 kills.

achievements.description: Successfully triggered 10 Vehicle Traps
achievements.summary: Successfully trigger 10 vehicle traps.

guide.context: Traps are in the countryside, not in town, and only work while police chase you. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Get the police called at the bar north-west of Sinclair Parish by the river fork.
Leave by the north exit and drive south-west on the main road. Three traps are along it.
Return and repeat until 10 have triggered.

achievements.description: Complete the Stones Unturned story mission "Creature of Habit".
achievements.summary: Complete the Stones Unturned story mission "Creature of Habit".

guide.context: Sniper Support unlocks in this mission.

steps.text: Play @loc{Creature of Habit} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Stones Unturned story mission "Devotchka".
achievements.summary: Complete the Stones Unturned story mission "Devotchka".

steps.text: Play @loc{Devotchka} to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the Stones Unturned story mission "Big Money".
achievements.summary: Complete the Stones Unturned story mission "Big Money".

steps.text: Play @loc{Big Money} to the end.

achievements.description: Eliminate a traitor in the Stones Unturned story.
achievements.summary: Eliminate a traitor in the Stones Unturned story.

steps.text: Play the Stones Unturned story until you eliminate a traitor.

achievements.description: Complete the Stones Unturned story mission "There Are No Dominos".
achievements.summary: Complete the Stones Unturned story mission "There Are No Dominos".

steps.text: Play @loc{There Are No Dominos} to the end.

achievements.description: Knocked out 30 people with the Dart Gun
achievements.summary: Put 30 people to sleep with the Dart Gun.

guide.context: You carry 12 darts at a time. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Start the Stones Unturned bounty hunting assignments to get the Dart Gun.
Use the Dart Gun on anyone you like. Civilians count.
Call the weapons van to refill when you run out.

achievements.description: Placed an unconscious person in the trunk of a car
achievements.summary: Put a knocked-out person into a car's trunk.

guide.context: It happens on its own in the assignments.

steps.text: Do the bounty hunting assignments; one has you put a knocked-out target in a trunk.

achievements.description: Killed 50 enemies using the Hartmann 7.62mm and wearing the Party Animal outfit
achievements.summary: Get 50 kills with the Hartmann 7.62mm in the Party Animal outfit.

guide.context: Underboss missions are an endless source of enemies. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Unlock the Hartmann when you assign the last region's rackets. It is free from Vito and costs $46,500 from anyone else.
Finish all bounty hunting assignments to unlock the Party Animal outfit.
Wear the outfit and kill 50 enemies with the Hartmann.

achievements.description: Completed all Bounty Hunting assignments
achievements.summary: Complete all Bounty Hunting assignments.

steps.text: Finish every bounty hunting assignment.

achievements.description: Killed 30 Enemies Using Sniper Support
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies using Sniper Support.

guide.context: Each charge costs $3,500. Underboss missions give plenty of enemies. It can crash the game, so avoid story missions. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Use Sniper Support on groups so each charge hits several targets.

achievements.description: You investigated the cult's activities at Sammy's
achievements.summary: Investigate the cult's activities at Sammy's.

guide.context: Sign of the Times missions use purple map markers.

steps.text: Play the Sign of the Times story until you investigate the cult at @loc{Sammy's}.

achievements.description: You met Bonnie Harless
achievements.summary: Meet Bonnie Harless.

steps.text: Play the Sign of the Times story until you meet @npc{Bonnie Harless}.

achievements.description: Investigated the 3 "Places of Darkness"
achievements.summary: Investigate the 3 "Places of Darkness".

steps.text: Play the Sign of the Times story and investigate all 3 Places of Darkness.

achievements.description: You killed Bonnie Harless
achievements.summary: Kill Bonnie Harless.

steps.text: Finish the Sign of the Times story arc by killing @npc{Bonnie Harless}.

achievements.description: Began Sammy's Renovation
achievements.summary: Begin Sammy's renovation.

steps.text: After the story arc, start the renovation at @loc{Sammy's}. It costs $20,000.

achievements.description: Protected Sammy's from the Dixie Mafia
achievements.summary: Protect Sammy's from the Dixie Mafia.

steps.text: Carry on with the renovation until the @enemy{Dixie Mafia} attack, and defend the bar.

achievements.description: Fully renovated Sammy's
achievements.summary: Fully renovate Sammy's.

steps.text: Pay for the remaining upgrades. The full renovation costs $186,000.

achievements.description: Killed 4 enemies using Slow-Mo Shooting 10 Times
achievements.summary: Kill 4 enemies in a single slow-mo shooting spell, and do that 10 times.

guide.context: It may only unlock after the slow-mo tutorial in Sign of the Times. A death still counts the slow-mo spells you finished. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one play sitting.

steps.text: Start slow-mo shooting and kill 4 enemies before the meter runs out.
Repeat 10 times. A police station gives many enemies.

achievements.description: Killed 20 enemies using Throwing Knives
achievements.summary: Kill 20 enemies using Throwing Knives.

guide.context: Throwing knives come from Sign of the Times. If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Kill with throwing knives and pick them up from the bodies.

achievements.description: Drove a distance of 50 km in the Samson Harrier
achievements.summary: Drive a distance of 50 km in the Samson Harrier.

guide.context: If your count seems not to save after you quit, finish it in one session.

steps.text: Hire the bartender at @loc{Sammy's} for $5,000 and finish his mission to unlock the @item{Samson Harrier}.
Drive it at high speed for about 11 to 12 minutes in total, or use it as your normal car.
